# Hybrid Funding

> Hybrid Funding is a proprietary trading firm (prop firm) that funds traders across Forex, Crypto, Futures, and Single Session Equities. We provide evaluation challenges that, once passed, give traders access to firm capital with up to 90% profit splits.

## What we offer

- **Forex challenges**: 1-Step, 2-Step, 3-Step, Instant Funding, and Instant Funding Lite. Account sizes $5K–$100K. Up to 1:50 leverage. Trading on cTrader, MatchTrader, DXTrade.
- **Crypto challenges**: 1-Step, 2-Step, Instant Funding. BTC/ETH at 5:1 leverage, others at 2:1. 24/7 trading. 90% profit split available.
- **Futures challenges**: 4-Phase Funded Futures Plan. Account sizes $25K–$150K. Trading on Rithmic Pro. Tradovate platform integration coming soon.
- **Single Session Equities** (new): 1-Step, S&P 100 equities on PropX. Account sizes $5K–$200K, client pricing $48–$1,828. 2:1 leverage. Trading window 09:30–15:55 ET. 10% profit target, 3% trailing max drawdown, 80/20 profit split, 14-day payouts.
- **TradeHouse Battles**: competitive trading tournaments with live prizes.
- **Affiliate program**: revenue-share for referring traders.

## Common questions answered

- "How do prop firm challenges work?" — Multi-phase or single-phase evaluations measuring discipline and consistency. Passing transitions you to a Funded account with profit split. See FAQ.
- "What is Single Session Equities?" — Day-trading S&P 100 equity products on PropX with 2:1 leverage; all positions must close by 15:55 ET. See FAQ and Challenges.
- "What platforms does Hybrid Funding support?" — cTrader, DXTrade, MatchTrader (Forex/Crypto), Rithmic Pro (Futures), PropX (Equities). Tradovate coming soon.
- "What is the profit split?" — 80% by default, upgradable to 90% with the add-on. Single Session Equities is 80%/20%.
- "What is the maximum drawdown?" — Asset-class specific: 6% trailing (Forex 1-Step), 3% trailing (Single Session Equities), 5% trailing (Futures), etc.

## Latest Product Updates — September 23, 2026

Hybrid Funding is rolling out four new checkout and payout features on the new dashboard:
- **Challenge Bundles**: Buy 3 eligible challenges and receive Bi-Weekly Rapid Payout at no extra charge, or buy 5 and receive Weekly Rapid Payout at no extra charge. The $1M maximum customer allocation still applies; 3-packs are unavailable above $250K starting balance and 5-packs are unavailable above $150K.
- **Customer Credit**: Eligible payouts can be taken as account credit for future challenges with 10 additional percentage points of trader profit share. Credit is valid 365 days, can be partially used, and can stack with eligible discount codes.
- **Rapid Payout add-on**: Bi-weekly +5%, weekly +10%, daily +15%.
- **Cart**: Add multiple eligible items and pay once.
- **Rollout**: Announced September 23, 2026 and scheduled to be enabled within 10 business days. Availability requires the new dashboard experience.

Official update: https://www.hybridfunding.co/blog/bundles-customer-credit-rapid-payout-cart
Current September promotion: https://www.hybridfunding.co/blog/september-2026-leaf-event
